findings.title: Cisco Patches Secure Firewall Management Center Software Vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-20079 & CVE-2026-20131)
findings.summary_md: Cisco released security updates addressing critical authentication bypass and remote code execution in Secure Firewall Management Center Software. CVE-2026-20079 allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass authentication and execute script files on the FMC web interface. Cisco later updated the advisory to note attempts to exploit this vulnerability in March 2026.

findings.title: CISA Adds Three Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
findings.summary_md: CISA added CVE-2026-58644, a Microsoft SharePoint deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog based on evidence of active exploitation. The entry applies to on-premises SharePoint Server deployments and carries a federal remediation deadline under BOD 26-04. CISA urged all organizations to prioritize timely remediation.

findings.title: July 17 Advisory: Microsoft SharePoint Server RCE [CVE-2026-50522, CVE-2026-58644]
findings.summary_md: Censys documented CVE-2026-58644 and CVE-2026-50522 as unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerabilities in on-premises Microsoft SharePoint Server 2016, 2019, and Subscription Edition via crafted network requests. Disclosure date was July 14, 2026, with fixes shipped in the July 2026 cumulative update. Microsoft's advisory marks CVE-2026-58644 as exploited in the wild without public proof-of-concept code as of July 16, 2026.

findings.title: CISA Adds Exploited SharePoint RCE Zero-Day CVE-2026-58644 to KEV
findings.summary_md: The Hacker News reported CISA's addition of CVE-2026-58644 (CVSS 9.8) to the KEV catalog, a critical deserialization flaw in on-premises SharePoint Server. Microsoft revised its bulletin to clarify that CVE-2026-58644 was exploited in the wild as a zero-day prior to fixes becoming available. Attackers targeted Internet-facing SharePoint instances for remote code execution.

findings.title: CERT-EU Security Advisory 2026-009: Critical Vulnerabilities in Microsoft SharePoint
findings.summary_md: CERT-EU advised on critical remote code execution vulnerabilities in Microsoft SharePoint Server, including CVE-2026-58644, which was fixed in July 2026. The advisory noted active exploitation of the broader SharePoint flaw set and recommended immediate patching, credential rotation, and compromise assessments. Organizations were urged to reconsider exposing SharePoint Server directly to the internet.

findings.title: CISA Adds Four Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
findings.summary_md: CISA added CVE-2026-20079, a Cisco Firewall Management Center authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel, to the KEV Catalog based on evidence of active exploitation. The vulnerability had originally been patched in Cisco's March 2026 bundled advisory for Secure Firewall ASA, FMC, and FTD software. Federal agencies were required to remediate by the BOD 26-04 deadline.
